data.one_liner: A Flutter widget for integrating Tawk.to live chat.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Tawk widget that wraps a web view to display a Tawk.to direct chat link inside a Flutter application. Supports custom visitor names, emails, secure mode hashes, loading placeholders, and link tap callbacks.
use_when: You want to integrate Tawk.to customer support chat into your Flutter application.
You need to pass visitor details like name, email, and secure mode hash to Tawk.to.
avoid_when: You need a custom in-house chat system rather than a Tawk.to integration.
You are targeting platforms other than Android, iOS, Windows, and macOS.
strengths: Easy integration with Tawk.to direct chat links.
Supports custom visitors and secure mode.
weaknesses: Depends on flutter_inappwebview which may add platform overhead.
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec.yaml and provide a Tawk direct chat link.
data.minimal_example:
Tawk(
    directChatLink: 'YOUR_DIRECT_CHAT_LINK',
    visitor: TawkVisitor(
        name: 'Ayoub AMINE',
        email: 'ayoubamine2a@gmail.com',
    ),
)
